subject: science

chapters.name: Chemical Reactions and Equations
learning_outcomes: Identify chemical reactions from observations
Write and balance chemical equations
Classify reactions: combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, redox
Explain effects of oxidation reactions in daily life (corrosion, rancidity)

chapters.name: Acids, Bases and Salts
learning_outcomes: Define acids, bases and salts in terms of H+ and OH- ions
Explain pH scale and its importance in daily life
Describe preparation, properties and uses of common salts
Understand water of crystallization
key_concepts: Common salts: NaCl, Na2CO3, NaHCO3, CaSO4·2H2O

chapters.name: Metals and Non-metals
learning_outcomes: Distinguish between metals and non-metals based on physical and chemical properties
Explain reactivity series and displacement reactions
Describe extraction of metals (roasting, calcination, electrolysis)
Understand corrosion and its prevention
key_concepts: Physical properties of metals and non-metals
Chemical properties: reaction with air, water, acids

chapters.name: Carbon and its Compounds
learning_outcomes: Understand catenation and tetravalency of carbon
Classify organic compounds: saturated/unsaturated, functional groups
Explain properties of homologous series
Describe soaps and detergents action
key_concepts: Functional groups: alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids
Chemical properties: combustion, oxidation, addition, substitution

chapters.name: Periodic Classification of Elements
learning_outcomes: Trace historical development: Dobereiner, Newlands, Mendeleev, Modern periodic table
Explain modern periodic law and periodic trends
Predict properties based on position in periodic table
key_concepts: Periodic trends: atomic size, valency, metallic/non-metallic character

chapters.name: Life Processes
learning_outcomes: Define nutrition, respiration, transportation, excretion in plants and animals
Explain autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition
Describe human digestive, respiratory, circulatory, excretory systems
Understand plant transport: xylem and phloem
key_concepts: Transportation in humans: blood, heart, vessels
Excretion in humans: kidney structure and function
exemplar_problems: Comparison of transport in plants vs animals

chapters.name: Control and Coordination
learning_outcomes: Explain nervous system: neurons, reflex arc, brain parts
Describe endocrine system: major glands and hormones
Understand plant coordination: tropisms, hormones
Compare nervous and hormonal control
key_concepts: Nervous system: CNS, PNS, neuron structure
Endocrine glands: pituitary, thyroid, pancreas, adrenal, gonads
Plant hormones: auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, abscisic acid

chapters.name: How do Organisms Reproduce?
learning_outcomes: Distinguish asexual and sexual reproduction
Explain modes of asexual reproduction: fission, budding, fragmentation, regeneration
Describe sexual reproduction in plants (flower structure, pollination, fertilization)
Describe human reproductive system and reproductive health
key_concepts: Human male and female reproductive systems

chapters.name: Heredity and Evolution
learning_outcomes: State Mendel's laws of inheritance
Explain monohybrid and dihybrid crosses
Understand sex determination in humans
Describe evidence for evolution: homologous, analogous organs, fossils

chapters.name: Light – Reflection and Refraction
learning_outcomes: State laws of reflection and refraction
Apply mirror formula and magnification for spherical mirrors
Apply lens formula and magnification for spherical lenses
Understand power of lens and its applications
key_concepts: Reflection: laws, spherical mirrors, image formation

chapters.name: Human Eye and Colourful World
learning_outcomes: Describe structure and functioning of human eye
Explain defects of vision and their correction
Understand dispersion of light through prism
Explain atmospheric refraction: twinkling stars, advanced sunrise/delayed sunset
Understand scattering of light: Tyndall effect, blue sky, red sunrise/sunset
key_concepts: Human eye structure: cornea, iris, pupil, lens, retina, optic nerve

chapters.name: Electricity
learning_outcomes: Define electric current, potential difference, resistance
State and apply Ohm's law
Understand factors affecting resistance
Calculate equivalent resistance in series and parallel
Explain heating effect of current and electric power
key_concepts: Electric power: P = VI = I²R = V²/R

chapters.name: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
learning_outcomes: Describe magnetic field and field lines
Explain magnetic field due to current-carrying conductor
State right-hand thumb rule, Fleming's left-hand rule
Describe electric motor and generator principles
Understand domestic electric circuits
key_concepts: Magnetic field and field lines properties
Magnetic field due to straight conductor, circular loop, solenoid
Force on current-carrying conductor in magnetic field
Domestic circuits: live, neutral, earth, fuse, earthing

chapters.name: Sources of Energy
learning_outcomes: Classify sources: renewable and non-renewable
Evaluate conventional sources: fossil fuels, thermal, hydro
Describe alternative sources: solar, wind, biomass, geothermal, tidal, nuclear
Understand environmental consequences and energy crisis
key_concepts: Conventional: fossil fuels, thermal power plant, hydro power plant
Non-conventional: solar, wind, biomass, geothermal, tidal, nuclear

chapters.name: Our Environment
learning_outcomes: Understand ecosystem components: biotic, abiotic, food chain, food web
Explain energy flow: 10% law, ecological pyramids
Describe ozone layer depletion and waste management
Apply reduce, reuse, recycle principles

chapters.name: Management of Natural Resources
learning_outcomes: Understand need for resource management
Describe water harvesting and watershed management
Explain forest and wildlife conservation
Understand coal and petroleum conservation
key_concepts: Water for all: dams, water harvesting
